allowed_downloads.purpose: pinned format, provenance, and license documentation
real sequential edit trace, Rust file
real sequential edit trace, Svelte component

audit_method.chronology: preserve transaction order; parse available ISO timestamps; measure monotonicity and timestamp resolution without sorting or inventing within-second order
audit_method.decode: gzip-decompress within the per-trace cap; parse JSON in memory and never emit raw source text
audit_method.grouping: keep each source file as a distinct group; note both traces share the same named recorder/author; do not create train/dev/test splits or claim author-held-out evaluation
audit_method.integrity: verify exact byte count and Git blob SHA-1 before parsing; compute SHA-256 after download
audit_method.replay: start at startContent; apply txn patches in stored order using Unicode codepoint offsets; verify descending positions within multi-patch transactions and exact endContent reconstruction

explicit_limits: Do not infer cursor position, selection, hesitation, undo/redo, acceptance, or developer intent beyond the recorded text patches and timestamps.
A patch stream is an ordered text-edit trace, not a complete IDE event log or a model-ready next-edit benchmark.
Do not train, upload, or use these traces as evaluation examples in this audit.
Do not download any other repository files or dataset releases.
